_help: Identity of this channel. Used to fill the {{placeholders}} in templates/ when building the two skills. See channels/README.md.
name: Maple Street English
niche: everyday English conversation for A2-B1 learners worldwide
tagline: everyday English, one street at a time
audience: adult and teen (16+) English learners at A2-B1 level worldwide, mainly Asia, Latin America and the Middle East
style: cute sticker-style chibi sitcom on a pastel street: a cast of neighbors, each episode at a different house or shop
studio_description: Produces ready-to-upload Maple Street English videos (16:9 episodes or 9:16 Shorts) from a finished script in videos/<topic>/script.txt: multi-voice dialogue, chibi-style dialogue scenes, repeat-after-me practice on Maple Street, synced captions, lesson cards, music, thumbnail, title, description and pinned comment. Use when the user asks to make, render, fix or publish a Maple Street video.
script_description: Writes Maple Street English scripts (A2-B1 English-learning sitcom episodes and Shorts set on Maple Street) plus a publish brief, following the channel bible's cast, places and episode format. Use when the user asks for a Maple Street script, episode ideas, target phrases, titles, or to rewrite a script. Does not render video.
